Proposal for approval · top-down, north up · four planets lie below the flight plane, each at its own depth: their disks are regions you fly over, and their coasts are the sites in the plane above them.
The Hollow's salvage broker: a Clan hauler went dark.
Its last beacon pointed past the belt, at the Haze.
Cross the Scatter. Ping (V) to see, and be seen, or run quiet.
Raiders strip it. Fight, or cut in. Its log names CINDER.
Down the dead colony's lift: one scene, a crew trait decides it.
Skirt the star's heat back to the Hollow. Repair, sell, hire.
The clue from CINDER opens it. The slice ends there.
About 5.5 min of the loop is travel. Cruise slows to
flight speed (120 m/s) within 1 km of anything you
can stop at, and builds to 8 km/s in open space.
Crossing VESHA takes about 20 s: its surface scrolls by.
cruise (ADR) · “?” contacts · a ping that gives you away
away-team scenes · named crew · fuel and supplies
CINDER, ORRO, PALE, the belt, the hauler, the gate
